Playbook.name: Core Banking App — Privilege Granted by Unexpected Administrator - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: In the core banking application, a privilege was granted by an administrator other than the approved one (GRANTED_BY != 3174, type 'Core Application'). Triage: unauthorised privilege grant in core banking, or a legitimate secondary admin?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Unauthorised privilege grants in core banking can enable fraud and unauthorised financial operations.

LogSources.LogSource: Core banking app audit via apps-* - apps-*

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Core banking app audit in apps-* (type 'Core Application'). Approved granter is GRANTED_BY 3174; others are unexpected.

Signal.Name: Privilege Granted by Unexpected Administ
Signal.Details: core-banking privilege granted by an unexpected admin.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the privilege grant by an unexpected admin is unauthorised or a legitimate secondary administrator.

Step.name: Privilege grants by this administrator
Step.Purpose: What privileges were granted, to whom, by the unexpected admin sets the risk.
Step.Query: FROM apps-* | WHERE type == "Core Application" AND GRANTED_BY == "$granted_by" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, GRANTED_BY, type | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 20
Step.AnalystNotes: Grants of high privilege by an unapproved admin, especially to suspicious users, are unauthorised. A legitimate secondary/backup admin performing expected grants is benign. Correlate the grantee and privilege in the app.

Node.Condition: High-privilege grants by an unapproved admin to unexpected users with no change record.
Node.Result: True Positive (Unauthorised Privilege Grant - escalate, fraud/compliance)

Node.Condition: A legitimate secondary/backup administrator performing approved grants.
An admin-account baseline gap (approved admin not in the allowlist).
Grant by an unexpected admin with unclear authorisation.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-OTH-GRANTS to the case.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm the admin; update the allowlist; close as false_positive.

TruePositive.Definition: An unauthorised privilege grant in core banking.

SOCAction.Item: Reverse the grants; review the admin account (compromise?); escalate to fraud/compliance; open IR.

Indicators.Item: Approved admin not in the allowlist (3174).

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Identify the grants and grantees; if unauthorised, reverse and review the admin.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Reverse the grants; review the admin account; escalate to fraud/compliance; open IR.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Maintain the approved-admin allowlist; enforce change control on privilege grants; alert on unexpected granters.

QualityChecks.Check: type 'Core Application'; approved granter GRANTED_BY=3174. Correlate grantee/privilege in the app.

FalsePositiveClosure.Item: Legitimate secondary admin confirmed; allowlist updated.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Grants reversed; admin reviewed; fraud/compliance engaged.
